pages.en: It's Mum's birthday. Lily and Tom want to make breakfast for her. They go into the kitchen very quietly.
pages.zh: 今天是妈妈的生日。Lily 和 Tom 想给她做早餐。他们悄悄地走进厨房。
pages.scene: Lily and Tom tiptoeing quietly into the kitchen early in the morning, fingers on their lips.

pages.en: Tom makes toast. Lily gets the butter, the jam and some orange juice from the fridge. Then she puts some fruit in a bowl.
pages.zh: Tom 做吐司。Lily 从冰箱里拿出黄油、果酱和一些橙汁，然后在碗里放了一些水果。
pages.scene: Tom making toast while Lily takes butter, jam and orange juice out of the open fridge, a bowl of fruit on the table.

pages.en: They put everything on a big plate and carry it upstairs. "Happy birthday, Mum!" Mum is very happy. "This is delicious. Thank you!"
pages.zh: 他们把所有东西放在一个大盘子上，端到楼上。“妈妈，生日快乐！”妈妈非常开心：“真好吃，谢谢你们！”
pages.scene: Mum sitting up in bed smiling, Lily and Tom holding a big plate with toast, jam, juice and fruit, a small card with a heart.
